cells.gaps: The coverage facts disagree: at December 2019 the SMIPF-SC was operational in every public health centre (MAR-013, MAR-014), worded as 100% with no numerator or denominator, while the newer March 2023 baseline has an integrated system deployed at hospitals and only begun in primary centres, with no count (MAR-026, MAR-027). No source says the health centres key their own reports (MAR-015), and nothing on coverage is dated after March 2023; finance:domestic (MAR-024, 2022) falls outside the 36 months.
cells.note: A national system takes the health centres' reports and facility entry by clinics is not published, which is stage 3. Stage 4 needs more than half of primary clinics entering their own reports on a share or count with a denominator, and the one share is of centres where the system is operational, undenominated and from 2019.

cells.gaps: The hospital system is stated as deployed in all public hospitals (MAR-029), which is not a count of hospitals using it; routine clinical use is evidenced at one university hospital (MAR-035, MAR-037). Primary-tier use rests on one province, where patient files are keyed afterwards by contracted clerks (MAR-038, MAR-039), and on an unsourced four-region claim (MAR-036), so T3 and T4 are not carried and digitised disagrees by tier. No share or count of primary clinics is published (MAR-006, MAR-030). The plan facet is left empty: framework law 06-22 (MAR-012, 2022) gives no period for the shared record, so plan:current is not established.
cells.note: Hospital deployment in all twelve regions with primary clinics in one province holding keyed patient files meets stage 3, the record staying in the facility. Stage 4 needs a shared record on a unique identifier in more than half of primary clinics, and the tender of 2024 and the draft law of 2026 both state that no shared record exists yet (MAR-034, MAR-001, MAR-002).
